lessonRef.subject: mathematics
lessonRef.title: Performance task planning: fraction word problems

sections.title: Instructional examples
sections.directions: This example shows how to justify a modelling choice.

items.prompt: Find 2/3 × 3/4. Write the answer in simplest form.

steps: Multiply the numerators: 2 × 3 = 6. This counts the shaded parts of the area model.
Multiply the denominators: 3 × 4 = 12. This counts all the parts the model is cut into.
That gives 6/12; the greatest common factor of 6 and 12 is 6, and 6 ÷ 6 = 1 over 12 ÷ 6 = 2, so the answer is 1/2.

sections.title: Guided practice
sections.directions: Decide what the quantities are before you compute anything.

items.prompt: 5 identical ribbon pieces are 9/11 meter each. What is their total length in meters?
Find 1/8 ÷ 2. Write the answer in simplest form.

sections.title: Extension and challenge
sections.directions: Plan in writing: what you will model, why that model, and how you will check it.

items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.
